stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Can it print the hut's notice?
stations.note: Today it is sticky tape on wood.

stations.title: Ticket hut
stations.text: Prints a good morning and an old offer.

stations.title: The notice
stations.text: Printed and ready for the hut window.

captions: Lanternquay Ferries. Bridie wants the notice on the ticket hut printed by a program.
Today the program prints a good morning and an offer that stopped, and no notice.
You write the statements that print it, in four small tasks.
Now the welcome, the times and the hours print, and the old offer is switched off.
One file, run with java. The computer talks, and Bridie has her notice.
